articles.title: This Space Peanut Wobbles Like a Top!
articles.summary: NASA's Lucy spacecraft flew past a peanut-shaped asteroid that doesn't spin like a normal rock — it wobbles! The asteroid, named Donaldjohanson, is only 155 million years old and once had water.

articles.title: Secret Animal Teamwork: How Different Species Talk to Each Other!
articles.summary: Animals don't just chat with their own kind — they also communicate with other species to work together! Birds lead humans to honey, fish clean bigger fish, and butterflies ask ants for protection.

articles.title: Math Whiz Cracks Wordle — Wins 99% of the Time!
articles.summary: Binghamton University researchers used a math trick called Shannon entropy to build a Wordle strategy that wins almost every game. The secret? Guess words that give the most clues, not the ones most likely to be right.
